payload.title: Regime-specialized coefficient experts
payload.statement: After the E011 notebook run is reviewed, split-local legal regime experts may recover additional nonlinear coefficient accuracy on demonstrably distinct well regimes while a confidence gate falls back exactly to the strongest verified global path.
payload.evidence_for: The official BirdCLEF+ 2026 first-place writeup shows that narrow specialists can add value inside a diverse validated ensemble. E010 shows that ROGII coefficient estimation and aggregation, not candidate coverage, explain 90.46% of selector regret.
payload.evidence_against: ROGII E007-E009 show that apparent regimes, model agreement, and aggregate gains can repeat shared spatial/typewell bias. Small regimes invite unstable routing and overfitting.
payload.next_test: Do not start before T020 reviews the saved E011 Kaggle outputs. Then preregister legal regime definitions, minimum sample sizes, cross-fitted routing, bounded coefficient actions, exact global fallback, full repeated/spatial/typewell/slice gates, and random/shuffled/sign-flipped routing controls.
